Restore this version?

That version goes into your draft so you can check it. Today’s draft is kept as a safety copy, and your live site doesn’t change until you publish.

It brings back business details, services, reviews, questions, updates, sections, pages, menu, header and footer, colours and fonts, and leaves your bookings, enquiries, contacts and files as they are now. A page it doesn’t have is kept 30 days in Recently deleted pages.
